verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented security scanning or inspection of listed or catalog MCP servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before agents use them. The Verify step only checks that an endpoint is reachable and speaks MCP. The dashboard test harness is a manual chat-and-logs tester. The "risk findings" and "risk policies" mentions have no stated link to pre-use server scanning. Blocking shadow servers and governance proxying are related access controls, not security scanning of servers.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
